Warren County Fiscal Court
Meeting Minutes
January 14, 2026
Pursuant to adjournment, Warren Fiscal Court met on Thursday, January 14, 2026
at 3:00 PM in the Warren County Fiscal Courtroom at 429 E 10th Avenue, Bowling
Green, Kentucky. Present were: Esquire Eric Aldridge, Esquire Ron Cummings,
Esquire Scott Lasley, Esquire Tom Lawrence, and Esquire Rex McWhorter, and
Esquire Rick Williams.
**********
Due to Judge Gorman’s absence and in accordance with KRS 67.040(2), Esquire
Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to elect Esquire Lawrence to
preside over the meeting. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered.
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve personnel
changes for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (2)
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter that court adjourn to
meet again on Thursday, January 22, 2026 at 9:00 AM. It is so ordered.
______________________________________
DOUGLAS J. GORMAN
WARREN COUNTY JUDGE EXECUTIVE
